an10.44:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kusinārāyaṃ viharati baliharaṇe vanasaṇḍe.
an10.44:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.44:2.1: Codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo.
an10.44:2.3: Codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:2.4: parisuddhakāyasamācāro nu kho 'mhi, parisuddhen' amhi kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena,
an10.44:2.5: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti?
an10.44:2.6: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
an10.44:2.7: iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū ti. Iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro. 4.
an10.44:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:3.2: parisuddhavacīsamācāro nu kho 'mhi, parisuddhen' amhi vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena,
an10.44:3.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti?
an10.44:3.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu parisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhena vacīsamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
an10.44:3.5: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vācasikaṃ sikkhassū ti. Iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro. 5.
an10.44:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:4.2: mettaṃ nu kho me cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ,
an10.44:4.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti?
an10.44:4.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno mettaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
an10.44:4.5: iṅgha tāva āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettaṃ cittaṃ upaṭṭhapehī ti. Iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro. 6.
an10.44:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:5.2: bahussuto nu kho 'mhi sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpā me dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā,
an10.44:5.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti?
an10.44:5.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo, ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhe kalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā, tassa bhavanti vattāro:
an10.44:5.5: iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū ti. Iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro. 7.
an10.44:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave codakena bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena evaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ:
an10.44:6.2: ubhayāni nu kho me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso,
an10.44:6.3: saṃvijjati nu kho me eso dhammo, udāhu no ti?
an10.44:6.4: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno ubhayāni pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anuvyañjanaso, ‘idam panāyasmā kattha vuttaṃ Bhagavatā' ti iti puṭṭho na sampāyati,
an10.44:6.6: iṅgha tāva āyasmā vinayaṃ sikkhassū ti. Iti 'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
an10.44:7.8: Codakena bhikkhave bhikkhunā paraṃ codetukāmena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ paccavekkhitvā ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo ti. 1.
